violation_type.title: Required Admission Information - Special School-age Permissions (26 TAC §744.605(14))
violation_type.short_title: Required Admission Information - Special School-age Permissions
violation_type.typical_finding: There was no documentation on file at the operation granting a child who attends the program to walk home. The enrollment form did not contain permission for the child to leave the program on their own.     NOTE:  The child was not in attendance during the inspection.

finding_variants.text: There was no documentation on file at the operation granting a child who attends the program to walk home. The enrollment form did not contain permission for the child to leave the program on their own.     NOTE:  The child was not in attendance during the inspection.
Four of the ten children files did not have waivers for the following;  Operational policy,  Immunization information,  and transportation/school age permission.
During the inspection, the name and telephone number of the school that a school-age child attends was not listed.
Six of the ten children files did not have waivers for the following;  Operational policy,  Immunization information,  Water activity  Transportation/school age permission.
Eight of the ten children files did not have waivers for the following;  Operational policy,  Immunization information,  Water activity  Transportation/school age permission.
Two children did not have school phone number in admission form.
